penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Building a behavioral-equivalence validation harness for COBOL-to-Java migrations requires deep per-engagement customization: ingesting the legacy codebase, mapping business rules, configuring numeric precision tests. This is professional services work, not a self-serve product.

penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: Selling into enterprise IT/consultancy requires discovery calls, scoping, and proposal cycles — no self-serve path at this price point.

penalties_applied.name: high_touch_support
penalties_applied.reason: Interpreting edge-case test failures in financial logic requires expert human judgment on an ongoing basis.

rationale: The pain is real and expensive — a precision bug in migrated banking COBOL can cost millions — and enterprise IT departments running migration projects clearly have budget. However, this is emphatically not an autonomous micro-service: every engagement requires loading a specific legacy codebase, understanding its numeric semantics, and customizing a test harness, which is irreducibly per-customer expert work. Operational autonomy scores 2 because delivery is effectively consulting. The build gate for operational_autonomy (min 7) is far unmet, and buildability_with_ai scores 3 because this genuinely requires specialized tooling beyond Claude prompts.
solution_plan: This opportunity does not pass the autonomy test for a solo non-technical operator running an AI factory. Building a behavioral-equivalence validator for COBOL-to-Java requires ingesting proprietary legacy codebases, writing custom numeric regression tests, and interpreting domain-specific financial logic — work that demands a skilled engineer on every engagement. Even if Claude could assist with parts of the analysis, selling to enterprise banks and consultancies requires sales cycles, NDAs, and expert delivery. A solo operator without a COBOL/Java engineering background cannot realistically build, sell, or maintain this. Recommended action: drop this candidate; revisit only if a strategic partnership with a migration consultancy is established.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy_min (scored 2, need 7) and buildability_with_ai_min (scored 3, need 6). This is a consulting/professional-services play, not an autonomous micro-service.
